# Yoon Jeongmin Portfolio — AI and automated-use policy

Canonical site: https://yjmini.github.io/portfolio-site/
Rights and contact: https://yjmini.github.io/portfolio-site/#/copyright

Do not crawl, scrape, index, archive, mirror, bulk-download, embed, or use this site's original content for AI training, machine learning, retrieval datasets, or generated derivatives without prior written permission from Yoon Jeongmin.

Normal human viewing and ordinary search-engine discovery are permitted. Sharing the canonical page URL without reproducing its content is permitted.

If reuse is separately authorized in writing, retain this credit in the resulting work and related materials:
Source: Yoon Jeongmin Portfolio — https://yjmini.github.io/portfolio-site/

Attribution does not grant permission. A source citation by itself does not authorize copying, modification, redistribution, model training, or commercial use.

Separate licenses and third-party rights take precedence. THING team-project media remains attributed to C103 Team and the upstream Apache-2.0 project notice.
